title: MCP vs RAG vs AI Agents
blurb: You don't choose between them — they solve different layers of the same system.
body:
Three concepts that get conflated constantly. They're not competitors; they're different layers of one stack.

MCP — a standard way for LLMs to use tools

An MCP host (Claude Desktop, an IDE, AI tools) runs MCP clients that speak the MCP protocol to servers, which in turn invoke web APIs, execute database queries, and read/write the filesystem. Standardized tool & resource access for LLMs.

RAG — LLMs augmented with retrieved knowledge

User query → a retriever fetches info from a knowledge base (PDFs, vector DB, code) → relevant docs are returned → query + docs go to the LLM → response. Runtime knowledge retrieval.

AI Agents — LLMs that take actions and make decisions

An autonomous reasoning & action loop: the agent perceives the environment, invokes tools (API calls, internet, code interpretation), keeps memory, delegates tasks, and acts with a configurable autonomy level under human control.

SOURCE · Chorouk Malmoum (Founder & CTO), LinkedIn.
